...you're right. I didn't.

text: I said I don't hand them out often. That's different.
rawContent: I said I don't hand them out often. That's different. || 我说的是那种话我不常说。这不一样

text: You remember exactly what I said and didn't say. Every time.

translation: 我说过什么、没说过什么，你每次都记得一清二楚

text: And now you're threatening me with a cat holding a cleaver.

text: Over the word 'secret'. As if you're the one being wronged here.
